evidence.statement: Single payload ops/research-clone/box-b/release_v2/payload.sql, 262273 bytes, sha256 3e852ebe78e6f1f2c4c2823251be2aee101d913d24186f785068474e7b76fbb8, built from frozen PR #529 inputs at 809093ee; reproducible from a fresh checkout of 84bcb90b.

On a local PostgreSQL 16.15 scratch cluster the payload applies as one simple-protocol batch to 20 distinct FINAL revisions and 41 receipts; failures roll back completely; ledger untouched. This is not DBClone evidence.

Target identity is delegated to the project-bound migration API (exact project ref nppznoujvnyjargjkmnv); the payload contains no identity claim. No Production credential was used and no database was contacted.
Residual risks: single-batch atomicity of the real Supabase migration endpoint and PG17 privilege behaviour are unverified; both Gamma and CLOB receipts come from Polymarket infrastructure.

Gate 1 stays HOLD (unclassified ops/ and tests/). The Founder approved a one-time, SQL-only, documented exception for payload 3e852ebe (GATE1_EXCEPTION.md). Recorded as an exception, not a PASS; static, PostgreSQL and control-plane checks remained mandatory and passed.

Independent R4 receipt committed in Git (release_v2/r4/): reviewed_sha 9bd9e320, verdict PASS, no blocking findings, next phase (DBClone apply via official API) NOT_READY. Reviewer was Read-only and did not recompute hashes or read raw provider bodies line by line (L319-513); parent evidence covers those.

DBClone write is forbidden by the Founder until separate authorization AND confirmation that the official Supabase API executes the payload atomically. Neither exists. No DBClone data was read or written, so 20 FINAL / 41 receipts / ACL / ledger in the real DBClone are unverified.
